newsitem.title: USA: N.Y professional workers sue state over pay -- paper.
newsitem.headline: N.Y professional workers sue state over pay -- paper.

text.p: A New York State labor union has filed a lawsuit against Gov. George Pataki and 31 commissioners to get overtime pay for hundreds of professional workers, the Albany Times Union reported Friday.
Public Employees Federation, which represents 52,000 professional, scientific and technical state workers, seeks back pay and damages for overtime worked from April 1994 to the present.

While the lawsuit, filed in state Supreme Court in Albany County, was brought on behalf of 390 union members, and if the union won, at least 10,000 of its members who earn more than $43,620 a year could be included.
The state union sued before on this issue but the case eventually was dismissed as it was filed in the wrong county, said a spokesman for the state attorney general.
